raw: One time I was making pancake batter, and a rotten egg spoiled it. There was this watery, greenish liquid in the mixing bowl, and the sulfur smell spread throughout the kitchen. That’s what I remember most—the smell, along with the sight of that liquid in something I was making to eat. It was really disgusting. I couldn’t think of it as pancake batter anymore; it was just a bowl of something rotten.
